props.name: size
props.description: Size variant; sets a `data-size` attribute.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between items; 0 joins them into one control.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant, styled with `cva`; sets a `data-variant` attribute.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected value of the toggle group when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected value of the toggle group.

props.name: deselectable
props.description:
Whether the toggle group allows empty selection.
**Note:** This is ignored if `multiple` is `true`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the toggle. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop focus inside the toggle group.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether to allow multiple toggles to be selected.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function to call when the toggle is clicked.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the toggle group.

props.name: rovingFocus
props.description: Whether to use roving tab index to manage focus.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected value of the toggle group.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.
